diagnosis.tone: Maps to STAGE_PRESETS varying only sampling params (temperature/top_p/top_k/repetition_penalty); the affect params (exaggeration, cfg_weight) are in TURBO_IGNORED_PARAMS. Prior four-arm receipt already measured preset shifts below same-parameter spread.
diagnosis.pace: Accepted and echoed; no synthesis code path consumed it before this fix.
diagnosis.pause_strategy: Accepted and echoed; no synthesis code path consumes it.

fix.pace: Implemented as deterministic pitch-preserving phase-vocoder time stretch (apply_pace_stretch) applied to the rendered waveform on every synthesize_to_file path. Per-render pace_effect receipt (chatterbox.pace_effect.v1) reports applied/reason and measured pre/post durations. Tempo factors: slow 0.85, measured 0.92, brisk 1.08, fast 1.18; unknown values are request_only.
fix.tone_and_pause_strategy: Declared request-only on chatterbox_turbo via chatterbox.voice_delivery_effect.v1, published in /health, /presets, per-render and batch receipts, with audible_channel pointers (intensity/valence/use_base_emotion -> chatterbox_base_affect; per-chunk pause_after_ms).

required_proof.protocol: 6x POST /synthesize-batch identical params for noise floor, then pace-varied renders; durations read from produced wav files with the wave module, never the echoed request.

assertions.no_overlap: every fast render (max 10.88s) < every slow render (min 13.941s) AND < min of 6 identical renders (12.04s)
assertions.deterministic_ratio: slow/fast group ratio 1.39 matches predicted 1.18/0.85 = 1.388; receipt output_duration equals wav-measured duration (2.037s == 2.037s in final smoke)
